missionParagraph1: !!!!!!!!! The core focus of BREACIL lies in the personalization of breast screening strategies. We believe that decisions regarding screening pathways should be guided by objective features extracted from breast images, rather than relying solely on subjective evaluations from a radiologist's visual assessment.
missionParagraph2: The resulting outcome is expected to be an earlier detection of breast cancer, minimization of false-positive biopsies, and an elevation of the standard of patient care and quality of life.
